name: s3CreateBucket
syntax: s3CreateBucket(bucketName [, acl, location, accessKeyId, secretAccessKey, host, timeout])

params.name: acl
params.description: An array of structs, one for each ACL grant.

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: The S3 access key ID. Defaults to the `lucee.s3.accesskeyid` system property or environment variable.

params.name: secretAccessKey
params.description: The S3 secret access key. Defaults to the `lucee.s3.secretaccesskey` system property or environment variable.

params.name: host
params.description: The hostname of an S3-compatible provider, without `https://`. Defaults to Amazon AWS.

rustcfml.notes: Names the first argument `bucket` and the secret key argument `secretKey`. `location` defaults to `us-east-1`. Doesn't list `timeout`.

examples.title: Create a bucket
examples.description: Creates a bucket in the default region.
